# HMSP.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp869.0 against Rp650.0 (expected total return 44.3%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Tobacco.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The lead driver misreads its own source. S4 says the government stopped raising CHT 'setelah kenaikan masing-masing 10 persen pada 2023 dan 2024' and has held rates 'sejak itu' - so 2025, 2026 and 2027 are all flat and t
- Capex is below depreciation for the whole forecast and into perpetuity (inputs.capex_pct 0.008 rising to 0.009; inputs.da_pct 0.012 falling to 0.011), so the asset base shrinks about 0.3% of revenue a year while terminal
- The cost-of-capital paragraph does not reconcile to model.valuation.coc. The rf actually used is 6.83% (7.45% less default_spread 0.0162, plus the 1.0% premium), not the 7.4% printed; the pre-premium COE is 10.53%, not 1

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
